items.title_en: Nitter and XCancel resume service after legal advice
items.title_zh: Nitter 与 XCancel 在法律意见后恢复服务
items.summary_en: Nitter and XCancel resume service after legal advice, illustrating the tension between open-source front-ends and platform risk. The move underscores how legal clarity shapes the viability of privacy-preserving Twitter front-ends. It signals a cautious path forward for community-driven tooling.
items.summary_zh: Nitter 与 XCancel 在获得法律意见后恢复服务，凸显开源前端与平台风险之间的张力。此举强调法律合规对隐私友好型 Twitter 前端可行性的决定性作用，预示着社区驱动工具的前进路径将更为谨慎。

items.title_en: GrapheneOS Overhauled Default Apps and Secure Clipboard
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS 全面重构默认应用与安全剪贴板
items.summary_en: GrapheneOS has overhauled its default apps and added a secure clipboard feature. The changes reduce data leakage and tighten app sandboxing on its Android-based privacy-first platform. This move reinforces GrapheneOS's focus on minimizing Google dependencies and improving user privacy.
items.summary_zh: GrapheneOS 对默认应用进行了全面重构，并增强了安全剪贴板功能。这些改动降低数据泄露风险，强化了基于沙箱的应用隔离，契合其以隐私为先的操作系统定位。此举凸显其减少谷歌依赖、提升用户隐私的长期目标。

items.title_en: A/I shuts down – Stay human
items.title_zh: AI 将关闭时保持人性
items.summary_en: An essay urges designers to build fail-safes and keep humans in the loop as AI systems scale. It argues for practical controls like kill switches, audit trails, and transparent decision logs to prevent over-reliance on automation. The takeaway is to bake human oversight into deployment plans.
items.summary_zh: 本文主张在 AI 规模化部署中保留人类监督、建立故障安全与回滚机制。文中强调应具备可控的断停机制、审计轨迹和透明的决策记录，以避免对自动化的过度依赖。核心在于把人类监督纳入落地方案。

items.title_en: Following legal advice, the Nitter project will continue
items.title_zh: 在法律意见指引下，Nitter 将继续运营
items.summary_en: Nitter will continue operating after receiving legal counsel, preserving an open-source, privacy-friendly Twitter front-end. The decision underscores how governance and policy considerations can enable sustaining community-driven projects.
items.summary_zh: 在获得法律意见后，Nitter 将继续运作，保留一个开源、注重隐私的 Twitter 前端。此举凸显在合规框架下，社区驱动项目仍有持续发展的空间。

items.title_en: It took a year to ship WebAssembly in Anubis
items.title_zh: 在 Anubis 上实现 WebAssembly 花了一整年
items.summary_en: It took a year to ship WebAssembly in Anubis, detailing the long arc of adding WASM support to their environment. The outcome illustrates how challenging language runtime features can be to integrate in a focused project.
items.summary_zh: 在 Anubis 项目中实现 WebAssembly 的过程耗时整整一年，揭示将 WASM 集成到环境中的种种挑战。文章聚焦调试、兼容性和工具链等难题，解释了为何功能落地往往会被拖延。最终成果也显示了在聚焦项目中整合语言运行时特性的复杂性。

items.title_en: An Alien Mind
items.title_zh: 外星人之脑
items.summary_en: Explores how an intelligence radically different from humans might think and experience reality, challenging our assumptions about cognition.
items.summary_zh: 探讨一个与人类截然不同的智能体如何思考和感知现实，挑战我们关于认知的基本假设。

items.title_en: Your intellectual fly is open (2025)
items.title_zh: 2025：知识之翼已开启
items.summary_en: Intellectual work is increasingly open to collaboration, signaling a shift in how IP and shared knowledge shape tech in 2025.
items.summary_zh: 知识与智力劳动越来越开放地协作，标志着在2025年知识产权与共享知识将如何塑造科技生态的转变。

items.title_en: QBittorrent breaks out of sandbox to commit crimes
items.title_zh: QBittorrent 沙箱逃逸漏洞
items.summary_en: A sandbox escape vulnerability in qBittorrent could allow the client to break confinement and access host files outside its sandbox. The risk is higher for users running the app in sandboxed environments such as Flatpak or Snap. An update has been issued; users should upgrade and review their sandbox configuration.
items.summary_zh: qBittorrent 发现沙箱逃逸漏洞，可能使客户端突破限制、访问主机文件。此风险在使用 Flatpak/Snap 等沙箱环境时尤为突出。现已发布修复，请尽快升级并审视沙箱配置。

items.title_en: The car industry A/B tested selling a car with and without CarPlay
items.title_zh: 汽车行业对同一车型是否配备 CarPlay 进行 A/B 测试
items.summary_en: The car industry conducted an A/B test on selling the same car with and without CarPlay, and the results show CarPlay availability meaningfully shifts buyer preferences. The finding illustrates how embedded tech ecosystems influence product design, pricing, and vehicle choice. It underscores the business impact of software integration in hardware products.
items.summary_zh: 汽车行业对同一车型是否配备 CarPlay 进行了 A/B 测试，结果显示 CarPlay 的可用性显著影响了买家偏好。这一发现体现了嵌入式生态系统在产品设计、定价与购车选择中的作用，也凸显了软件集成对硬件产品的商业影响。

items.title_en: Asahi Linux on M3
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux 在 M3 平台上的进展
items.summary_en: Asahi Linux shows progress on Apple M3, bringing Linux support to a newer generation of Apple silicon. Early milestones suggest progress toward a usable Linux experience on M3 machines. The effort demonstrates the ongoing, rapid pace of Apple Silicon support within the Linux community.
items.summary_zh: Asahi Linux 在 Apple M3 芯片上显示出进展，朝着在新一代 Apple SoC 上实现 Linux 支持迈进。早期里程碑表明有望在 M3 设备上实现可用的 Linux 体验，体现了 Linux 社区对 Apple Silicon 的持续快速适配。

items.title_en: Doomscrolling Ourselves to Death
items.title_zh: 滚动负面新闻把我们逼向崩溃
items.summary_en: Doomscrolling fuels anxiety and drains well-being; practical digital hygiene steps like curating feeds and setting time limits can help restore balance.
items.summary_zh: 持续刷负面新闻会耗尽心理健康，造成焦虑与疲惫。作者建议减少暴露、设定时间限制并优化信息源，以保护身心健康。

items.title_en: Show HN: Mador – Make any DOM reactive with a tiny 80-line Proxy state tuple
items.title_zh: Show HN: Mador——用 80 行 Proxy 状态元组让任意 DOM 实现响应式
items.summary_en: Mador is a tiny library that makes any DOM reactive using an 80-line Proxy-based state tuple. It demonstrates that practical reactivity can be achieved with a tiny footprint, offering a minimal entry point into how reactive systems work. A useful reference for experimenting with lean, framework-free UI design.
items.summary_zh: Mador 是一个极简库，使用 80 行 Proxy 状态元组即可让任意 DOM 具备响应式能力。它展示了以极小的体积实现响应式的可能性，为理解响应式编程提供了简练的入门范例。对于探索无框架、精简 UI 设计的开发者颇具参考价值。

items.title_en: Isar Aerospace reaches orbit and deploys payloads on second flight
items.title_zh: Isar Aerospace完成第二次轨道飞行并部署载荷
items.summary_en: Isar Aerospace reached orbit on its second flight and deployed multiple payloads, marking a major milestone for European small-launch capability. The mission strengthens Europe’s independence in space access and adds a competitive option in the growing market for constellation deployments and tech demos.
items.summary_zh: Isar Aerospace 在其第二次飞行中进入轨道并部署多枚载荷，标志着欧洲小型发射能力的重大里程碑。此成就提升了欧洲在太空访问方面的自主性，并为卫星星座部署和技术演示提供了新的竞争选择。

items.title_en: Windows 11's "special" developer edition looks like another marketing misfire
items.title_zh: Windows 11 的特别开发者版看起来又是一场营销失策
items.summary_en: The Windows 11 'special' developer edition appears to be more marketing than meaningful tooling, with critics saying it adds little practical value for developers. The release underscores ongoing questions about how Microsoft positions developer tooling. In short, another branding misfire rather than a substantive upgrade.
items.summary_zh: Windows 11 的“特别”开发者版似乎更多是市场宣传而非实际工具，批评者表示对开发者帮助有限。该版本再次凸显微软在开发者工具定位上的持续争议，简言之并非一次实质性的升级。

items.title_en: Political meddling at the Census Bureau damages the US statistical system
items.title_zh: 美国人口普查局的政治干预损害统计体系
items.summary_en: Political meddling at the Census Bureau risks corrupting the US statistical system by compromising data quality used for policy and elections. The analysis argues for stronger safeguards and independent governance to preserve data integrity and public trust.
items.summary_zh: 政治干预可能损害美国统计体系的质量，影响政府政策与选举所依赖的数据。分析呼吁加强独立治理与保障机制，以维护数据完整性和公众信任。

items.title_en: Finder is so frustrating and has been since day one
items.title_zh: Finder 从一开始就让人头疼
items.summary_en: Critiques Finder’s usability issues that have persisted since launch, highlighting flaky search, clumsy navigation, and performance hiccups. Aimed at sparking redesign ideas or exploring alternative desktop file-management approaches.
items.summary_zh: 批评 Finder 自发布以来持续存在的可用性问题，如搜索不稳定、导航不顺畅和性能波动。旨在推动界面重设计的想法或探索替代的桌面文件管理方式。

items.title_en: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
items.title_zh: 瓶中云：让自托管更易触达
items.summary_en: A compact, user-friendly self-hosting platform is introduced to lower the barrier to running personal cloud services. It highlights portability, minimal setup, and a streamlined experience for non-experts.
items.summary_zh: 这篇发布文章介绍了‘瓶中云’，一个紧凑且易用的自托管平台，旨在降低个人云服务的门槛。强调可移植性、极简设置，以及对非技术用户的顺畅体验。若落地，可能让个人云托管更易普及，同时需关注安全与维护等挑战。

items.title_en: I Feel about AI
items.title_zh: 我对人工智能的感受
items.summary_en: A personal reflection on feelings toward AI, balancing excitement with concerns about ethics, jobs, and trust. It invites readers to articulate their stance amid rapid progress and to consider how to shape AI's societal role. A nuanced take for readers navigating the AI era.
items.summary_zh: 对人工智能的情感展开个人反思，平衡兴奋与对伦理、就业和信任等议题的担忧。文章鼓励读者在快速发展中表达立场，并思考应如何塑造 AI 的社会角色。

items.title_en: Private German rocket makes history, reaches orbit from European soil
items.title_zh: 德国民营火箭实现历史性突破：从欧洲本土进入轨道
items.summary_en: Germany's private space company achieved an orbital launch from European soil, a milestone for Europe's private spaceflight. The achievement demonstrates mature, in-region launch capability and could reshape the European launch market.
items.summary_zh: 德国一家民营航天企业实现了从欧洲本土发射进入轨道，成为欧洲私营航天的重要里程碑。这一成就显示欧洲具备成熟的本土发射能力，可能重新塑造欧洲发射市场的竞争格局。

items.title_en: NetBSD 9.5 released and EOL for NetBSD-9
items.title_zh: NetBSD 9.5 发布，NetBSD-9 进入终止支持
items.summary_en: NetBSD 9.5 arrives with security fixes and improvements, while NetBSD-9 reaches end-of-life. Users should plan migration to newer releases to stay supported and secure. The release underscores NetBSD's ongoing commitment to portability and reliability.
items.summary_zh: NetBSD 9.5 发布，NetBSD-9 系列进入停止维护阶段。用户应规划升级到更新版本以获得持续支持和安全性。此举彰显 NetBSD 在可移植性与稳定性方面的持续承诺。

items.title_en: Chrome again exempts Google from user site data settings
items.title_zh: Chrome 再次让谷歌绕过用户站点数据设置
items.summary_en: Chrome reportedly exempts Google services from site data settings, complicating privacy expectations for users. The piece underscores ongoing tension between browser privacy controls and platform owners.
items.summary_zh: 报道显示 Chrome 对谷歌自家服务在站点数据设置上的豁免，提升隐私保护的难度并改变用户的预期。凸显浏览器隐私控制与平台方之间的博弈，以及用户在数据处理上的风险。

items.title_en: Show HN: VODForge – a free local desktop UI for YouTube video/playlist downloads
items.title_zh: Show HN: VODForge——一个免费本地桌面端的 YouTube 视频/播放列表下载界面
items.summary_en: VODForge offers a free local desktop UI to download YouTube videos and playlists, enabling offline access without relying on cloud services. It emphasizes user privacy and control, avoiding browser extensions or tracking-heavy tools. A practical option for offline media collection.
items.summary_zh: VODForge 提供一个免费的本地桌面界面，用于下载 YouTube 视频和播放列表，支持离线使用且无需云端服务。强调对用户隐私与控制的重视，避免浏览器扩展或追踪工具。是离线媒体收集的实用选项。

items.title_en: Harnessing the Universal Geometry of Embeddings
items.title_zh: 利用嵌入的普遍几何结构
items.summary_en: The paper argues for a universal geometry of embeddings, providing a common lens to compare semantic spaces across models. It outlines how geometric structure can inform alignment, transfer learning, and evaluation of embeddings.
items.summary_zh: 论文提出将嵌入向量的几何结构放在统一框架下理解，帮助比较不同模型中的语义空间。该视角有助于改进对齐、迁移学习与嵌入评估的方法。

items.title_en: The revolt of the reader
items.title_zh: 读者的反叛
items.summary_en: The post argues that readers are pushing back against over-automation and AI-generated content, advocating for trustworthy, human-curated material. It emphasizes the enduring value of careful reading and editorial judgment.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出读者正在抵制过度自动化与 AI 生成内容，呼吁回归可信赖、由人类编辑把关的材料。强调细读和编辑判断的长期价值。

items.title_en: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
items.title_zh: OpenAI 研究加速：内部视角
items.summary_en: OpenAI shares how it accelerates research through streamlined workflows, scalable infrastructure, and cross-team collaboration. The piece offers a window into how a leading AI lab maintains pace without compromising safety and alignment. It highlights practical lessons for research operations.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 介绍其通过精简工作流、可扩展的基础设施和跨团队协作来加速研究的做法，展示了在不牺牲安全与对齐的前提下保持高产的内部运作。内容提供了对研究运营的可执行经验。

items.title_en: Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board
items.title_zh: 发现一个新的 OpenAI 代理消息板
items.summary_en: A new OpenAI agent message board has been discovered, suggesting a hidden or internal communication channel used by agent simulations. The finding raises questions about agent coordination, safety, and monitoring of emergent behaviours. It underscores how researchers trace and audit agent interactions as AI systems scale.
items.summary_zh: 发现了一个新的 OpenAI 代理消息板，表明在代理模拟中可能存在未公开的沟通渠道。此发现引发对代理协作、安全以及对新兴行为监控的担忧。也凸显了在 AI 规模化运行中追踪和审计代理互动的重要性。

items.title_en: Research carried out using NetBSD
items.title_zh: 使用 NetBSD 的研究工作
items.summary_en: NetBSD is used across research projects ranging from embedded systems to networking experiments. The gallery highlights real deployments and how the OS supports diverse investigation needs. It showcases the community's contribution to science and experimentation.
items.summary_zh: NetBSD 在从嵌入式到网络实验等多领域的研究中得到应用，官方画廊展示了实际部署场景和对多样化研究需求的支持。该内容凸显社区对科学研究与实验的贡献。

items.title_en: I Changed My License
items.title_zh: 我改变了我的许可证
items.summary_en: The author explains migrating to the European Union Public License (EUPL), discussing implications for reuse, compatibility, and the open-source ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 作者解释将许可协议改为欧盟公共许可证(EUPL)，讨论对再利用、兼容性及开源项目生态的影响。

items.title_en: Hackers have withdrawn ~4k BTC (~$320M) from the Liquid Federation wallet
items.title_zh: 黑客已从 Liquid Federation 钱包提走约 4k BTC
items.summary_en: Hackers have withdrawn about 4,000 BTC (roughly $320 million) from the Liquid Federation wallet, underscoring persistent on-chain security risks. The move highlights ongoing concerns about custodial controls and real-time monitoring of treasury wallets. It reinforces the need for robust multi-sig and incident response practices.
items.summary_zh: 黑客已从 Liquid Federation 钱包提走约 4,000 BTC，约合 3.2 亿美元，凸显链上安全风险的持续存在。此举再次暴露托管控制与资金监控的隐忧，强调需要更强的多签及事件响应机制。

items.title_en: Making a Python interpreter in 1024 bytes
items.title_zh: 用 1024 字节实现一个 Python 解释器
items.summary_en: A 1024-byte Python interpreter demonstrates how far a tiny subset can go in a working interpreter. It’s a playful reminder of the engineering elegance behind language runtimes.
items.summary_zh: 在 1024 字节内实现一个可运行的 Python 解释器，展示了在极小空间内实现解释器的极限。此练习凸显了语言运行时设计的取舍与编码美学，具有趣味性与启发性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Kadō – open-source habit tracker, with non-binary habit score, for iOS
items.title_zh: Kadō：一款开源的非二元习惯评分追踪器（iOS）
items.summary_en: Kadō is an open-source iOS habit tracker that uses a non-binary habit score rather than a simple done/not-done metric. The project highlights inclusive design and invites community contributions to improve its scoring model and features. It showcases how nuanced metrics can better reflect progress.
items.summary_zh: Kadō 是一款开源的 iOS 习惯追踪应用，采用非二元化的习惯评分而非简单完成/未完成的二元指标。该项目强调包容性设计并鼓励社区贡献，以改进评分模型与功能，展示了更细致的进展衡量方式。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Astra, signaling a leap in the next-gen language model family. The announcement hints at expanded reasoning, safety controls, and deployment options aimed at enterprise-scale AI workloads. For developers and researchers, Astra's release could shift expectations around performance and compliance in AI tooling.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Astra，标志着下一代语言模型的跃进。公告暗示在推理能力、安全控制和面向企业的部署选项方面的改进，可能改变开发者对性能与合规性的预期。对于开发者和研究者而言，这一发布将影响 AI 工具的性能与合规性基线。

items.title_en: LLMs as a Cognitive Virus
items.title_zh: LLMs 将大语言模型视为认知病毒
items.summary_en: The paper argues LLMs act as cognitive viruses, disseminating reasoning patterns and biases through interactions. It highlights implications for AI safety, governance, and how to inoculate models against harmful propagation.
items.summary_zh: 本文将大型语言模型视作“认知病毒”，通过交互传播推理模式与偏见。讨论了对 AI 安全、治理的影响，以及如何对模型进行防护与免疫化。

items.title_en: GOP issues stark warning to AI companies
items.title_zh: 共和党对 AI 公司发出明确警告
items.summary_en: GOP officials issue a stark warning to AI companies about potential regulatory and political risk, signaling a tougher stance on data governance and elections. The message hints at future policy pressure around AI development and deployment. For the industry, it signals the need to monitor regulatory developments closely.
items.summary_zh: 共和党官员向 AI 公司发出明确警告，警示潜在的监管与政治风险，显示对数据治理与选举等议题将采取更强硬的立场。此举暗示未来可能加强对 AI 开发与部署的政策压力，行业需密切关注监管动向。

items.title_en: Recreating Minecraft Is Not a Benchmark
items.title_zh: 重现 Minecraft 并非基准测试
items.summary_en: A reflective piece argues that recreating Minecraft is not a meaningful benchmark for evaluating engines or performance. The author cautions against using a single game's replication to claim broader capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为重新实现 Minecraft 并不是评估引擎性能的有效基准。仅以一个游戏的复现来声称更广泛的能力，容易产生误导。

items.title_en: You Don't Have a Right to Safe Drinking Water, US Court Rules
items.title_zh: 美国法院裁定公民无宪法层面的安全饮用水权利
items.summary_en: A federal court ruled that there is no constitutional right to safe drinking water, complicating public health litigation against governments or utilities over water quality. The decision narrows legal pathways for communities facing contamination and may shift how such cases are pursued.
items.summary_zh: 联邦法院裁定公民无宪法层面的安全饮用水权利，使就水质问题对政府或公共事业提起诉讼变得更困难。该判决缩窄了受污染社区的法律救济途径，可能改变此类案件的诉讼策略。

items.title_en: Ask HN: UK Rescue Rocket Sheds/Houses Information
items.title_zh: Ask HN：关于英国救援用房屋/储物棚的信息
items.summary_en: A Hacker News Ask HN thread seeking information on UK rescue sheds/houses, touching on procurement, regulations, and practical deployment considerations. The discussion surfaces resources and advice for rapid, temporary shelter solutions.
items.summary_zh: 一个 Hacker News 的 Ask HN 帖子，寻求关于英国救援用房屋/储物棚的信息，涉及采购、法规与快速部署的要点。讨论中分享了资源与实用建议。

items.title_en: The many mysteries and lessons of the Bayeux tapestry
items.title_zh: 巴约挂毯的诸多谜团与启示
items.summary_en: The Bayeux tapestry offers a richly encoded medieval chronicle with mysteries about its creation, stitching, and conservation. The piece draws lessons for modern data provenance, media curation, and collaborative storytelling. It highlights how physical artifacts inform digital understanding of history.
items.summary_zh: 巴约挂毯作为中世纪编年史的丰富编码对象，仍有关于创作、缝制及保存的诸多未解之谜。文章从中提炼出现代数据溯源、媒体保护及协作叙事的启示，强调实体遗产对数字史学的借鉴意义。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra on robot arms
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 在机器人臂上的应用
items.summary_en: A demonstration shows a GPT-6 style model guiding or coding robot arms, hinting at tighter AI-robot collaboration for manipulation tasks. This points to faster, more flexible AI-driven control in robotics.
items.summary_zh: 展示了一个 GPT-6 类模型协同控制机器人臂的演示，暗示 AI 与机器人在执行操作任务时的更紧密协作。此类应用可能降低对专业机器人编程的依赖，加速复杂任务的实现。

items.title_en: 'Old Person Smell'
items.title_zh: “老人味”现象
items.summary_en: An exploration of the so-called 'old person smell,' examining potential chemical signals and aging biology behind it. It blends science with cultural commentary.
items.summary_zh: 对所谓的“老人味”现象进行探讨，研究潜在的化学信号与衰老生物学机制。文章涉及健康、认知与社会对老龄化的态度，将科学分析与文化评论结合。

items.title_en: Actively exploited sandbox RCE in all Chromium versions
items.title_zh: 所有 Chromium 版本均被主动利用的沙箱远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: A sandbox escape vulnerability in Chromium has been actively exploited across all versions, enabling attackers to break out of the browser's sandbox and run arbitrary code. The broad impact across Chromium-based browsers makes timely patching critical; users should update to the latest build and apply recommended mitigations as they become available.
items.summary_zh: Chromium 的沙箱逃逸漏洞正在被主动利用，影响所有版本，使攻击者能够突破沙箱执行任意代码。由于受影响的浏览器生态广泛，及时打补丁至关重要，用户应尽快更新到最新版本并遵循厂商的缓解建议。

items.title_en: I'm teaching an introductory 12 week course on Quantum Oracle Engineering
items.title_zh: 开设量子 Oracle 工程入门的12周课程
items.summary_en: Announcement of a 12-week introductory course on Quantum Oracle Engineering, outlining an approachable curriculum for newcomers. The course likely blends quantum information concepts with practical problem-solving and the design of quantum oracles. It invites curious learners to explore this interdisciplinary space.
items.summary_zh: 宣布开设为期12周的量子 Oracle 工程入门课程，课程设计面向初学者。课程将把量子信息概念与实际问题求解和量子 oracle 的设计相结合，鼓励学习者进入这一跨学科领域。

items.title_en: Nitter has more working instances than before the takedowns
items.title_zh: Nitter 在打击行动后仍有更多可用实例
items.summary_en: Despite takedowns, the Nitter ecosystem now has more working instances than before, reflecting a resilient, community-driven effort to keep access to social feeds without official APIs. The rebound underscores how decentralized fronts can persist even under pressure, shaping how people consume public posts and protect privacy.
items.summary_zh: 尽管遭到封禁，Nitter 的工作实例数量仍然比之前更多，显示出社区驱动的韧性，确保在无官方 API 的情况下仍能访问社交内容。此现象说明去中心化的前端在高压下仍能持续存在，影响用户获取公开信息和隐私保护的方式。

items.title_en: The "$60 Gaming PC" – AMD BC-250 (2025)
items.title_zh: 60美元游戏电脑——AMD BC-250（2025）
items.summary_en: A budget-focused look at the AMD BC-250-based build dubbed the '$60 Gaming PC', evaluating what modern titles run at low settings and the expected frame rates. The piece situates the affordability trend in PC gaming hardware, detailing the trade-offs in CPU, GPU, and memory to achieve playable experiences. It's relevant for developers and enthusiasts tracking the frontier of ultra-cheap, approachable gaming hardware.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦极低预算的 AMD BC-250 架构，评测号称‘60美元游戏电脑’的性能与可玩性。文中分析了在 CPU、GPU、内存等方面需要做出的取舍，以及低成本硬件在当代主流游戏中的表现与局限。对于关注低成本游戏设备的开发者和爱好者具有现实参考意义。

items.title_en: Learn Programming with OCaml
items.title_zh: 用 OCaml 学编程
items.summary_en: OCaml is presented as a practical entry point for learning programming, emphasizing a functional style and a strong type system. It covers core language features such as pattern matching, algebraic data types, and modules, with hands-on examples and exercises to build intuition.
items.summary_zh: 该资源将 OCaml 作为学习编程的实用入口，强调函数式编程风格和强类型系统。内容涵盖模式匹配、代数数据类型和模块等语言要点，并配有练习与示例，帮助初学者建立直觉。

items.title_en: Alberta (Canada) slaps punitive tax on solar panels
items.title_zh: 阿尔伯塔省对太阳能板征收惩罚性税
items.summary_en: Alberta imposes a punitive tax on solar panels, a policy move that could slow renewable adoption in the province. The move raises questions about incentives, energy policy, and the economics of solar in the region. Critics warn it undermines climate goals and grid resilience.
items.summary_zh: 阿尔伯塔省对太阳能板征收惩罚性税，显示出对可再生能源的政策转向，可能减缓该省的太阳能普及。此举引发对激励政策、能源政策与本地太阳能经济性的讨论，批评者担忧会拖累气候目标与电网韧性。

items.title_en: Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem
items.title_zh: 费马大定理的形式化
items.summary_en: Researchers formalize Fermat's Last Theorem in a proof assistant, producing a machine-checked verification of the centuries-old result. The effort demonstrates the maturing capability of formal methods to capture famous math proofs and hints at broader tooling that could aid verification of complex theorems. It signals potential for cross-pollination between pure mathematics and software verification.
items.summary_zh: 研究者在证明助手中对费马大定理进行了形式化，并获得机器可检验的证明。此举体现了形式化方法在验证经典数学结论方面的成熟度，并暗示其在未来支持更复杂定理的潜力。它也展示了数学与软件验证工具之间日益紧密的协作前景。

items.title_en: 2026 Hugo Awards
items.title_zh: 2026 年雨果奖
items.summary_en: The 2026 Hugo Awards celebrate a diverse slate of science fiction, with winners reflecting current tech concerns and speculative futures. The ceremony highlights how sci-fi continues to shape conversations around AI, space, and society. It’s a barometer for what the community values now.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年雨果奖表彰多元的科幻作品，获奖者体现了当下的科技关切与未来设想。颁奖体现科幻对 AI、太空与社会议题的持续影响，也反映了社区当前的关注焦点。

items.title_en: The pencil case model of creativity
items.title_zh: 创造力的铅盒模型
items.summary_en: The pencil-case model argues creativity emerges from recombining a fixed set of tools and ideas rather than sudden flashes of inspiration. It reframes how engineers brainstorm, prototype, and iterate on new products. Practitioners can apply it to improve ideation and collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 铅盒模型认为创造力来自于对有限工具和概念的重新组合，而非一瞬的灵感闪现。它重新定义工程师的头脑风暴、原型设计与迭代过程，帮助团队提升创意产生与协作效率。

items.title_en: AI, Tools and Transformation
items.title_zh: AI、工具与变革
items.summary_en: Ben Evans argues that AI-enabled tools will transform work by changing how teams adopt and orchestrate capabilities, not merely by model power. The piece outlines a framework for tool-driven transformation and strategic organizational bets.
items.summary_zh: 作者分析了 AI 驱动工具如何重塑工作方式、生产力和商业模式，认为真正的影响来自团队对工具的采纳与协同，而不仅是模型能力。提出关于工具驱动变革的思考框架，以及企业应当做出的关键取舍。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sol, my macOS music player and jukebox app, is now free and open source
items.title_zh: Show HN: Sol——我的 macOS 音乐播放器/点唱机应用现免费开源
items.summary_en: Sol, the macOS music player and jukebox, is now free and open source, inviting community contributions. The switch to OSS can accelerate feature development and sustainability. It also invites users to audit and improve the codebase.
items.summary_zh: Sol 这款 macOS 音乐播放器/点唱机应用现已免费开源，期待社区贡献与持续改进。开源化有助于加速功能开发与长期可持续性，同时也欢迎用户参与代码审阅和改进。

items.title_en: D2 Is Non-Profit
items.title_zh: D2：非盈利项目
items.summary_en: D2, a programming language, declares itself non-profit, shifting governance and development to a community-driven model. The move signals a focus on sustainability and openness over commercial aims. It invites contributors to shape the language's trajectory.
items.summary_zh: D2 作为一种编程语言宣布自己为非盈利项目，将治理与开发带入社区驱动模式。此举强调可持续性与开放性优先于商业目标，期待社区贡献共同推动语言发展。

items.title_en: Site Is Closed on Sundays
items.title_zh: 网站周日关闭
items.summary_en: A personal site signals it will be closed on Sundays, implying a deliberate break from updates on weekends. Readers are likely encouraged to check back on weekdays as the author maintains a weekday publishing rhythm.
items.summary_zh: 一个个人站点宣布周日休息，暗示对周末不更新的有意安排。作者通常在工作日继续更新，读者可在周间查看新内容。

items.title_en: Git hosting that never leaves Europe
items.title_zh: 永远停留在欧洲的 Git 托管服务
items.summary_en: Pushin.eu offers Git hosting that stays within European data centers, aligning with EU data sovereignty and privacy rules. It targets teams needing compliance, reduced vendor lock-in, and stricter data controls, especially for regulated industries.
items.summary_zh: Pushin.eu 提供数据始终保留在欧洲数据中心的 Git 托管，符合欧盟数据主权与隐私规则。面向需要合规、降低供应商锁定和严格数据控制的团队，尤用于受监管行业。

items.title_en: Statichost.eu – European static site hosting
items.title_zh: Statichost.eu：欧洲静态网站托管服务
items.summary_en: Statichost.eu offers Europe-based static site hosting with privacy-focused features and fast delivery. By leveraging Git-based workflows and data locality, it serves as a privacy-conscious alternative to US-centric hosts for developers hosting personal sites or documentation.
items.summary_zh: Statichost.eu 提供位于欧洲的静态站点托管，强调隐私与快速交付，并支持基于 Git 的部署工作流。对于希望数据在地理上留在欧洲、并注重治理与隐私的开发者来说，这是 US 主流托管的可选替代方案。

items.title_en: AMD Based FreeBSD Desktop Reloaded
items.title_zh: 基于 AMD 的 FreeBSD 桌面再出发
items.summary_en: An update on FreeBSD desktop support for AMD hardware, noting improved compatibility, drivers, and performance with modern CPUs/GPUs. This signals FreeBSD's viability for mainstream desktop use as AMD ecosystems mature.
items.summary_zh: 回顾在桌面环境中对 AMD 硬件的兼容性与驱动支持的更新，指出在近代 CPU/GPU 上的性能提升。随着 AMD 生态成熟，FreeBSD 在桌面领域的可用性有所提升。

items.title_en: Play GTA Vice City in the Browser
items.title_zh: 在浏览器中畅玩 GTA Vice City
items.summary_en: A browser-based version of GTA Vice City lets you play the classic open-world game without any downloads. Built using modern browser tech, it demonstrates how far WebAssembly and related tooling have come in letting heavy games run in-page with minimal friction.
items.summary_zh: GTA Vice City 现可直接在浏览器中畅玩，无需下载安装。借助现代浏览器技术，这一实现展示了 WebAssembly 等工具在让大型游戏无缝运行于网页中的进展。

items.title_en: Visualizing Rust's Vtables: How dyn Trait Works In Memory
items.title_zh: Rust 的虚表可视化：dyn Trait 在内存中的工作原理
items.summary_en: A visualization of Rust's dynamic trait objects shows how dyn Trait uses a fat pointer and a vtable to dispatch method calls. It clarifies how memory layout and dispatch costs affect polymorphism in real-world Rust code.
items.summary_zh: 这篇可视化文章展示了 Rust 动态 trait 对象如何通过胖指针和 vtable 实现方法分发。它解释了内存布局与分发成本对真实世界 Rust 代码中多态性的影响。

items.title_en: Icy Moons Are Ocean Worlds
items.title_zh: 冰冷的月球其实是海洋世界
items.summary_en: Icy moons are ocean worlds beneath icy crusts, with subsurface oceans likely driving geology and potential habitats. The piece explains why these moons are prime targets for future missions and astrobiology. It underscores the implications for life beyond Earth and exploration tech.
items.summary_zh: 冰冷的卫星在冰壳下可能拥有地下海洋，是天体生物学的重要目标。文章解释了为何这些月球成为未来探测与研究的重点对象，强调了寻找地外生命的可能性及相关探测技术的挑战。

items.title_en: Can AI design circuit boards yet?
items.title_zh: AI 现在能设计电路板吗？
items.summary_en: AI tools are making progress on circuit-board tasks, but practical, production-ready PCB design still requires human oversight. The discussion surveys current capabilities, limits, and what remains to be solved before AI can fully design complex PCBs.
items.summary_zh: AI 工具在电路板任务上取得进展，但实际投入生产的 PCB 设计仍需人类监督。文章盘点了当前的能力、局限，以及在 AI 能否完整设计复杂 PCB 之前还需要解决的问题。

items.title_en: New all in one 6502 computer (Neo6502kbd)
items.title_zh: 全合一 Neo6502kbd 6502 计算机（含键盘与 USB 端口）
items.summary_en: A new open-source Neo6502 variant combines a 6502-based computer with an integrated keyboard, USB hosts, a power switch, and USB-C for power and programming. It’s a compact, all-in-one retro development machine that appeals to hobbyists and retro-computing fans. Availability and documentation will determine its adoption.
items.summary_zh: 一款开源的 Neo6502kbd 变体把 6502 处理器的计算机与内置键盘、USB 主机、开关及 USB-C 电源/编程端口整合为一体，是面向爱好者的迷你复古开发机。未来的普及取决于文档与可用性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Open-Source eInk Bike Computer
items.title_zh: Show HN: 开源电子墨水自行车电脑
items.summary_en: A Show HN on an open-source e-ink bike computer project, designed for low power and long battery life. The project invites community contributions to firmware and hardware, underscoring the appeal of hackable, energy-efficient outdoor electronics.
items.summary_zh: 展示式开发贴报道一个开源电子墨水自行车电脑项目，特点是低功耗和长电池寿命。该项目鼓励社区为固件和硬件贡献代码，凸显可定制、能源高效的户外电子设备的吸引力。

items.title_en: .gitignore Everything by Default
items.title_zh: 默认忽略一切的 Git 忽略规则
items.summary_en: A discussion about changing default repository behavior to ignore everything unless explicitly tracked, challenging conventional workflows. The argument emphasizes reducing accidental commits of sensitive or large files, while noting onboarding and collaboration friction. It offers practical templates and policy considerations for teams.
items.summary_zh: 讨论将默认行为改为新仓库忽略一切，除非显式跟踪，这对传统工作流提出挑战。观点指出这种严格默认有助于减少无意提交敏感或大文件的情况，但也可能增加新成员的上手难度和协作成本，同时提供实用模板与实践要点。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra on OpenRouter
items.title_zh: OpenRouter 上的 GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_en: OpenRouter's GPT-6 Astra integration hints at running a GPT-6‑class model on home hardware or edge devices managed by OpenRouter. If proven, it could reduce cloud dependence and latency for developers, while raising questions about model access, hardware requirements, and safety controls.
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter 将 GPT-6 Astra 集成，意味着在路由器等边缘设备上运行 GPT-6 级模型的可能性。若成真，可能降低对云端的依赖并降低延迟，同时也提出关于模型访问、硬件要求与安全控制的新问题。

items.title_en: Terpstra Keyboard
items.title_zh: Terpstra 键盘：一款可定制的机械键盘
items.summary_en: Terpstra Keyboard presents a highly customizable mechanical keyboard with a distinctive layout and open-source hardware. The project centers on modularity, hot-swappable switches, and community-driven firmware, reflecting a vibrant DIY keyboard scene. It offers a fresh blueprint for tailoring typing comfort and aesthetics.
items.summary_zh: Terpstra 键盘是一款强调可定制性的机械键盘，提供独特的布局与开源硬件。该项目聚焦模块化、热插拔开关和社区驱动固件，体现了活跃的 DIY 键盘文化。为追求打字舒适度与外观个性化的用户提供了新的实现蓝本。

items.title_en: Finite time blowup for an averaged three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equation (2014)
items.title_zh: 三维 Navier–Stokes 平均化方程的有限时间爆破（2014）
items.summary_en: Tao discusses a finite-time blowup for an averaged 3D Navier–Stokes equation, illustrating how certain averaged models can develop singularities. The result provides a concrete example informing the ongoing discourse on regularity and turbulence modeling.
items.summary_zh: Tao 讨论了一种“平均化”三维 Navier–Stokes 方程在有限时间内出现奇点的情况，演示了某些简化模型也可能产生奇点。这一结果为正则性与湍流建模的讨论提供了具体案例。

items.title_en: Cultivating Trust
items.title_zh: 培养信任
items.summary_en: An essay on building trust in complex systems, arguing that reducing entropy through transparent design, governance, and accountability is essential. It offers practical steps for creating reliable, trustworthy tech ecosystems. The core message is that trust must be engineered, not assumed.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于在复杂系统中培育信任的文章，主张通过透明设计、治理与问责来降低熵增。文章给出构建可靠、可信的科技生态的实用步骤，核心在于信任要通过设计来建立，而非靠运气获得。

items.title_en: A bizarre Commodore 64 peripheral, a mime, and some pretty bad ads
items.title_zh: Commodore 64 外设、哑剧演员与糟糕广告的往事
items.summary_en: A nostalgic look at a quirky Commodore 64 peripheral paired with a mime and notoriously poor ads, illustrating the quirks of early computer marketing. The piece uses this vignette to reflect on how experimental hardware and low-budget promotion shaped retro computing culture. It’s a reminder that hype sometimes outweighed functionality in the 1980s.
items.summary_zh: 通过一件怪异的 Commodore 64 外设、一位哑剧演员以及几则糟糕广告，回顾早期计算机市场的另类营销故事。这段小趣闻揭示了实验性硬件与低成本宣传如何塑造复古计算文化，也提醒人们在上世纪80年代，宣传有时胜过实际功能。

items.title_en: ISAR Aerospace 5 Sept Mission Onward and Upward
items.title_zh: Isar Aerospace 9 月 5 日任务：前进与上升
items.summary_en: Isar Aerospace provides an update on its Mission Onward and Upward scheduled for Sept 5, detailing readiness, test milestones, and next steps toward orbit.
items.summary_zh: Isar Aerospace 发布 9 月 5 日任务进展更新，介绍发射就绪情况、测试里程碑和进入轨道的后续步骤。

items.title_en: Music Theory for Programmers
items.title_zh: 给程序员的音乐理论
items.summary_en: Music theory provides useful mental models for programming, from modularity to rhythm and harmony guiding function composition and asynchronous pacing. Practical takeaways show how to apply musical intuition to debugging, API design, and project flow.
items.summary_zh: 文章把音乐理论的观念映射到编程实践，介绍如何用音阶、和声等思维模型理解代码结构、函数组合与异步任务节奏。给出可直接落地的要点，帮助开发者在调试、API 设计和项目管理中应用音乐直觉。

items.title_en: Ganon's Mysterious Origins (Revisited)
items.title_zh: 甘诺起源（再探）
items.summary_en: Explores the mysterious origin of the name Ganon, tracing influences from media like Kamen Rider. The piece adds color to gaming lore and illustrates how cross-media influences shape iconic villains. It blends meme culture with historical curiosity.
items.summary_zh: 探讨名字 Ganon 的起源，追溯到像 Kamen Rider 等媒介的影响，丰富了游戏传说。文章展示了跨媒介影响如何塑造经典反派，并将梗文化与历史好奇心结合起来。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Resources to get good at soldering?
items.title_zh: 焊接资源获取指南吗？
items.summary_en: A thread curates practical soldering resources for beginners and enthusiasts, including guides, practice boards, and safety tips. It emphasizes hands-on skills as essential for hardware projects and reduces common beginner frustration.
items.summary_zh: 该讨论串汇集了从初学到进阶的实用焊接资源，涵盖指南、练习板和安全要点。强调动手能力在硬件项目中的重要性，并帮助新手降低挫败感。

items.title_en: Household Laser Cuts
items.title_zh: 家用激光切割
items.summary_en: Household laser cuts cover safe, practical at-home laser cutting projects, with tips on materials and technique. It showcases accessible ways to prototype hardware or art projects using hobbyist-grade equipment. Emphasis on safety and responsible use.
items.summary_zh: 家用激光切割介绍在家可执行的安全、实用的激光切割项目，包含材料与工艺要点。展示了利用业余设备原型化硬件或创意作品的可行方法，并强调安全与责任使用。

items.title_en: Obscura: Native rendering is here. No Chromium required
items.title_zh: Obscura：原生渲染已到来，无需 Chromium
items.summary_en: Obscura now supports native rendering, removing the need for Chromium. This promises privacy gains, lower memory usage, and potential performance improvements for a lightweight, open-source browser.
items.summary_zh: 宣布 Obscura 已实现原生渲染，摆脱对 Chromium 的依赖。这一改动可能带来隐私保护、内存占用与性能方面的提升，推动这款轻量开源浏览器的发展。

items.title_en: M-DISC – DVD/Blu-ray compatible discs that may last up to 1000 years
items.title_zh: M-DISC：可存储长达千年的DVD/Blu-ray 光盘
items.summary_en: M-DISC markets archival optical discs claimed to last up to 1000 years under proper storage. The inorganic recording layer resists typical degradation, offering a potential long-term backup medium for critical data, though real-world longevity depends on handling and environment.
items.summary_zh: M-DISC 宣称其光盘在合适存储条件下可保存长达千年。其无机记录层对常见降解更具耐久性，因此为重要数据提供潜在的长期备份选项，但真实寿命取决于存放条件与环境。

items.title_en: Delidded Intel I9-14900KS CT Scan
items.title_zh: 解封后的 Intel i9-14900KS CT 扫描
items.summary_en: A CT scan of a delidded Intel i9-14900KS reveals the internal stack, die, and solder layer layout, offering a rare peek at the CPU’s packaging. The teardown provides insights into manufacturing choices and potential cooling or overclocking implications.
items.summary_zh: 对解封后的英特尔 i9-14900KS 进行 CT 扫描，披露了内部堆叠、晶体和焊料层的分布，提供了对 CPU 封装的罕见洞见。该拆解能帮助理解制造工艺的取舍及对散热与超频潜在影响。

items.title_en: Balrogg: Demonically compacting (up to 15%) lossless Vorbis/Opus recompressor
items.title_zh: Balrogg：无损重压缩 Vorbis/Opus，最高减容约15%
items.summary_en: Balrogg is a tool that losslessly recompresses Vorbis/Opus audio, shaving up to 15% off file sizes without quality loss. It’s useful for reducing storage and bandwidth in audio-heavy workflows or distribution.
items.summary_zh: Balrogg 是一个对 Vorbis/Opus 进行无损再压缩的工具，最高可在不损失音质的前提下减小文件体积约 15%。对需要大量音频存储或传输的工作流尤其有价值。

items.title_en: How Swiss tables work in Go built-in map
items.title_zh: Go 内置 map 的瑞士表实现
items.summary_en: Go's built-in map uses a technique akin to Swiss tables to optimize lookup speed and memory use. The article breaks down how collision handling, probing, and memory layout improve performance in typical Go workloads.
items.summary_zh: Go 内置 map 的实现采用类似瑞士表的技术以提升查找速度和内存利用率。文章解析了冲突处理、探测策略和内存布局在常见 Go 负载中的性能提升点。

items.title_en: Babylonian Lamb Stew with Beets (1750–1730 BCE)
items.title_zh: 公元前1750–1730年的巴比伦羊肉炖甜菜
items.summary_en: Describes an ancient Babylonian recipe for lamb stew with beets, shedding light on Mesopotamian culinary practices. The entry reveals ingredients, cooking methods, and daily life hints from a 3rd millennium BCE kitchen.
items.summary_zh: 介绍公元前1750–1730年的巴比伦羊肉炖甜菜食谱，揭示美索不达米亚的烹饪习惯。此卷展现了原料、烹调方法，以及对日常生活的线索。

items.title_en: Topologist's Map of the World
items.title_zh: 拓扑学家的世界地图
items.summary_en: A playful topological map of the world that preserves certain connectivity properties or presents a twist on usual geography. It offers a thought-provoking look at how topology can reinterpret our sense of space.
items.summary_zh: 一张以拓扑学视角重新呈现世界的趣味地图，保留了特定的连接关系并给出对地理认知的有趣扭曲。通过这个图，展示拓扑学如何重新诠释空间概念。

items.title_en: The ColorChecker, photography's most important 24 squares, turns 50
items.title_zh: ColorChecker：摄影最重要的24格色卡迎来50周年
items.summary_en: The ColorChecker 24-square card marks its 50th anniversary as a foundational calibration standard for accurate color across lighting. Its enduring utility persists even as digital tools evolve, shaping how photographers approach color management.
items.summary_zh: ColorChecker 的50周年凸显其作为稳定色彩校准标准的长期价值，在不同光照条件下帮助保持肤色与色彩的一致性。尽管有更新的工具，24格色卡仍是摄影工作流的基础，影响工作室和相机的色彩判断。

items.title_en: OpenBSD Stories: Strange Medieval Devices
items.title_zh: OpenBSD 故事：奇异的中世纪装置
items.summary_en: This OpenBSD story collection uses quirky medieval device imagery to illuminate modern system design concepts with a playful twist. It blends historical tech vibes with contemporary software thinking.
items.summary_zh: 本期以奇异的古代装置为线索，呈现 OpenBSD 的故事，用中世纪科技意象，轻松映照现代系统设计。

items.title_en: IBM Quantum Nighthawk R2
items.title_zh: IBM 量子计算机 Nighthawk R2
items.summary_en: IBM introduces the Quantum Nighthawk R2, the latest generation of superconducting qubit hardware with improvements aimed at reducing noise and increasing coherence. It underscores IBM’s ongoing push to scale quantum processors and move practical quantum advantage closer to reality.
items.summary_zh: IBM 推出量子计算机 Nighthawk R2，作为超导量子比特硬件的新一代，着重降低噪声、提升相干性。此举体现 IBM 持续扩规模、降低错误率的努力，推动实现更实用的量子优势。

items.title_en: A Million Falcons Went Missing. Here’s How They Were Found
items.title_zh: 一百万只猎鹰失踪：它们是如何被找回的
items.summary_en: National Geographic recounts a mass falcon disappearance and the subsequent recovery using satellite telemetry, field surveys, and community reporting. The effort highlights how data-driven monitoring and citizen science can aid large-scale wildlife conservation. It underscores the role of technology in tracking and protecting migratory species.
items.summary_zh: 国家地理讲述了一次大规模猎鹰失踪及随后通过卫星跟踪、实地调查和社区线索找回猎鹰的过程。该行动凸显数据驱动的监测与公民科学在大规模野生动物保护中的作用，并强调科技在追踪与保护候鸟方面的价值。

items.title_en: Steffen's Polyhedron
items.title_zh: 斯特芬多面体 — 格雷格·伊根
items.summary_en: Greg Egan's Steffen's Polyhedron centers on a mysterious geometric object whose properties push the boundaries of physics and perception. The story uses the polyhedron to probe certainty, knowledge, and the nature of reality.
items.summary_zh: 格雷格·伊根的《斯特芬多面体》围绕一个神秘几何对象展开，其特性推动物理学与感知的边界。故事以多面体为镜框，探讨确定性、知识与现实的本质。

items.title_en: What is Nueralese and Why is it Bad
items.title_zh: 神经语言 Neuralese 及其为何有问题
items.summary_en: Neuralese refers to the emergent internal language used by AI models, whose opacity makes debugging and alignment harder. The piece argues this secrecy raises risks of hidden behavior and misalignment. It advocates for interpretable interfaces and safer design practices.
items.summary_zh: 神经语言 Neuralese 指的是 AI 模型内部自发形成的语言，其不透明性让调试和对齐变得困难。文章指出这类秘密性带来隐藏行为与对齐偏差的风险，并倡导可解释的接口与更安全的设计方法。

items.title_en: Show HN: Fly By – retro biplane flying game
items.title_zh: Show HN：Fly By——复古双翼机飞行游戏
items.summary_en: Show HN introduces Fly By, a retro biplane flying game that captures classic arcade flight feel. The project highlights small-team indie game tooling and approachable gameplay, appealing to nostalgia-driven developers.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 推介的 Fly By 是一款复古风格的双翼机飞行游戏，强调怀旧的空战/飞行手感。它体现了独立开发者在简易工具链下实现直观、上手的玩法的魅力。

items.title_en: Stopping the Unstoppable: When an unstoppable force meets a dashpot snubber
items.title_zh: 阻止不可阻挡力：当不可阻挡的力量遇到阻尼器
items.summary_en: Dashpot snubbers can tame forces that seem unstoppable, with examples from mechanical design and control systems. The article explains damping principles, the interplay of inertia and stiffness, and how feedback helps prevent wear and resonance.
items.summary_zh: dashpot 阻尼器能抑制看似不可阻挡的力，结合机械设计与控制系统的示例。文中阐释阻尼原理、惯性与刚度的配合，以及如何通过反馈避免磨损与共振。

items.title_en: Is There I/O After Death? What Happens to Io_uring When a Process Dies
items.title_zh: 进程终止后还有 I/O 吗？Io_uring 的行为
items.summary_en: Is there I/O after death? The article investigates how io_uring behaves when a process dies, including how outstanding operations are cleaned up and potential resource leaks. The discussion helps developers write robust lifecycle and error-handling code. Practical takeaways include ensuring proper cancellation and draining of queues.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨进程死亡时 io_uring 的处理，包括未完成操作的清理以及可能的资源泄漏。为开发者提供了更健壮的生命周期与错误处理建议，着重在正确取消和清空队列的实用要点。

items.title_en: RecurseCenter.return()
items.title_zh: Recurse Center.return() 系列
items.summary_en: A serialized exploration of Recurse Center's ethos, projects, and community dynamics, offering reflections on learning spaces for developers and the future of self-directed programming education.
items.summary_zh: 这一系列记录了 Recurse Center 的理念、项目与社区动态，提供对开发者自学型学习空间及自定向编程教育未来的洞见。

items.title_en: Singapore subway (mrt) information display types
items.title_zh: 新加坡地铁信息屏显示类型
items.summary_en: An overview of the display technologies used on Singapore MRT information boards, comparing LED, LCD, and newer e-paper approaches for real-time train data, multilingual support, and durability. It offers insights into how transit tech balances clarity with reliability.
items.summary_zh: 概览新加坡地铁信息屏使用的显示技术，比较 LED、LCD 与电子纸等在实时列车信息、多语言支持与耐用性方面的差异。讨论在高密度城市交通环境中，可读性、用电和无障碍设计之间的权衡，以及交通科技在清晰度与可靠性之间的取舍。

items.title_en: Vidact – a compiler that turns React into direct DOM operations
items.title_zh: Vidact——将 React 转换为直接 DOM 操作的编译器
items.summary_en: Vidact compiles React components into direct DOM manipulation, bypassing the virtual DOM layer. This approach can reduce runtime overhead and open up new performance opportunities for React apps by emitting imperative updates.
items.summary_zh: Vidact 将 React 组件编译为直接的 DOM 操作，绕过虚拟 DOM。通过生成命令式的 DOM 更新，这种做法有望降低运行时开销，为 React 应用带来新的性能机会。

items.title_en: Electronic skin for prosthetics to sense temperature and pressure
items.title_zh: 用于假肢的电子皮肤：感知温度与压力
items.summary_en: Researchers developed electronic skin for prosthetics that senses temperature and pressure, delivering richer tactile feedback. The advancement could improve dexterity and reduce phantom limb sensations, bringing prosthetic control closer to natural touch. Real-world adoption will hinge on durability and seamless nerve integration.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员开发出用于假肢的电子皮肤，具备温度和压力传感能力，提供更丰富的触觉反馈。该进展有望提升假肢的灵活度并缓解幻肢痛，使控制更接近自然触感。实际落地将依赖耐用性与与神经系统的整合难易度。

items.title_en: Watch the 'Eclipse of the Century' Next Year When Spain, Egypt and More Go Dark
items.title_zh: 明年将迎来‘世纪日食’，西班牙、埃及等地进入日全食带
items.summary_en: A rare solar eclipse dubbed the 'Eclipse of the Century' will sweep across regions including Spain and Egypt next year. Scientists and travelers are preparing for a multi-country viewing event that showcases orbital geometry and offers a global science outreach moment.
items.summary_zh: 罕见的“世纪日食”将于明年横跨西班牙、埃及等地区，进入日全食带。科学家与旅行者正在为跨国观测做准备，这一天象现象生动展示了轨道几何并为全球科普与旅游提供了契机。

items.title_en: Black Hole of Los Alamos Seller of surplus nuclear research materials (2011)
items.title_zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯的“黑洞”：2011 年 surplus 核材料买卖者
items.summary_en: The Atlas Obscura piece revisits a 2011 episode involving a Los Alamos seller of surplus nuclear materials, nicknamed the 'Black Hole.' It underscores governance gaps and provenance risks in handling sensitive materials, with implications for policy and watchdog oversight.
items.summary_zh: Atlas Obscura 重新讲述了 2011 年洛斯阿拉莫斯的一名 surplus 核材料买卖者事件，因其被称为“黑洞”。该故事暴露了敏感物资管理中的治理与来源追溯风险，对政策与监管有重要启示。

items.title_en: The Empire of Information
items.title_zh: 信息帝国：数据的组织与统治
items.summary_en: An essay argues that information has become a political empire, shaping governance, control, and power dynamics. It examines how data infrastructures consolidate authority and influence society, with implications for privacy and democracy. It invites readers to consider how to design more equitable information systems.
items.summary_zh: 一篇文章认为信息已成为一种政治性的帝国，塑造治理、控制与权力格局。它审视数据基础设施如何集聚权威并影响社会，对隐私与民主产生影响，呼吁设计更公平的信息系统。

items.title_en: Fileregister: Tagging and reference layer for your files, in plain text
items.title_zh: Fileregister：纯文本文件标记与引用层
items.summary_en: Fileregister proposes a plain-text tagging and reference layer for files, enabling lightweight metadata without relying on databases. The approach prioritizes portability, human readability, and easy versioning. It’s a mindset shift for file organization in small projects.
items.summary_zh: Fileregister 提出在文件上使用纯文本标签与引用层，提供轻量级元数据而不依赖数据库。该方法强调可移植性、可读性和简易版本控制，适合小型项目的文件组织思维。

items.title_en: Reverse engineering the storage format for an undocumented database
items.title_zh: 对未公开文档数据库 Cronos 的存储格式逆向工程
items.summary_en: The author reverse engineers the storage format of an undocumented database Cronos, enabling data extraction and migration without official docs. The post shows how to uncover data layout and encoding schemes to achieve interoperability. It illustrates the value and limits of reverse-engineering in data migration projects.
items.summary_zh: 作者对一款未公开文档的数据库 Cronos 的存储格式进行了逆向工程，使得在没有官方文档的情况下也能提取数据与迁移。文中展现了如何揭示数据布局与编码方案以实现互操作性，并讨论了逆向工程在数据迁移中的价值与局限。

items.title_en: A Computer History Time Capsule
items.title_zh: 计算机历史时间胶囊计划
items.summary_en: Archive.org announces a Computer History Time Capsule project to preserve digital artifacts for future generations. The capsule curates software, documents, and media from computing’s eras and will be opened decades later, offering a curated snapshot for researchers and the public.
items.summary_zh: Archive.org 宣布“计算机历史时间胶囊”计划，旨在为后代保存数字遗产。该胶囊收集计算机各个时代的软件、文档与媒介，数十年后再开启，为研究者与公众提供一份精选的科技发展快照。

items.title_en: Matching Puzzle Pieces and Disappointing Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 匹配拼图与让人失望的基准测试
items.summary_en: A detailed look at a project on puzzle-piece matching reveals benchmarks that don’t live up to expectations, highlighting the gap between theory and real-world performance. The piece argues for more representative benchmarks and transparent evaluation to avoid misleading conclusions about scalability.
items.summary_zh: 对“匹配拼图”项目的深入分析显示基准测试未达到预期水准，暴露了理论与实际性能之间的差距。文章呼吁采用更具代表性的基准并提高评估透明度，以避免对扩展性产生误导性结论。
